device.model: HD8240 / GI Black Synaps (System ID 0A040A00, 1.7.01 EMU build)
device.type: Full HD DVB-S2 / DVB-T / DVB-C receiver with CA, CI and Ethernet
device.board: 0A040A00 (Fulansoft / Synaps ALi M3606B Lemontree EuP platform, stb_board_type = 2)
device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB0 at I2C 0x33
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 DVB-S2 on SCB0 at I2C 0x60

image.version: 1.7.01 Black Synaps GI (maincode(AV) "0A040A001701"; bootloader "M3606B 1.1.3", 2010-09-06; seecode "M3606 SEE", 2016-03-31)

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko / Galaxy Innovations firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko / Galaxy Innovations (gisclub.tv Black Synaps mod)
source.note: Archive amiko_0A040A00_black synaps_gi_1.7.01_gisclub.tv.rar from the Amiko/Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as an M3602-family board with chip ID 0x3603 (C3603, chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_hd8240_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8240_capture_screen.py): under 0x3603 the "M3606B 1.1.3" bootloader maps the 8 MB flash in the 16 MB window at 0xAF000000, prints "APP  init ok", parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1E8F2A8, exchanges CRC-16/XMODEM frames (" ON " -> "    ") with the Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit LED microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 44 (SCL) / 43 (SDA), and unpacks maincode(AV) to 0x80000200.  The application starts "M3606 SEE" at 0xA7000200 (EBase 0x80000000 / 0x80000001), updates the Lemontree panel to " on ", configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60 ("stb_tuner_type = 1, stb_board_type =2."), and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog (9 GE commands, 30 colours).

desc: Amiko HD8240 / Galaxy Innovations Black Synaps (System ID 0A040A00) firmware 1.7.01 (2016-04-01) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3606B / C3603 Full HD receiver.

Pairs dual-CPU M3606 maincode + seecode ("M3606 SEE" at 0xA7000200) with a Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit LED MCU at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 44 / 43 (" ON " -> " on "), ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
